description: [SAM TTS](https://samtts.com) is a specialized online platform that recreates the iconic Microsoft SAM voice synthesizer originally found in Windows XP. This tool utilizes a modern JavaScript implementation to bring the classic Speech API (SAPI4) experience directly to web browsers without requiring any software downloads.
